record_scope_reconstruction: The formal Skouw–Wutung road crossing is identified on both sides. Initial January/February 2020 PNG restriction must remain separate from the later pandemic closure; later 2022 reopening cannot erase the intervening lifting reported in the canonical chronology.

October 27 2022 report says the Wutung post reopened Monday for PNG citizens travelling to Jayapura.
Distinguishes PNG Wutung reopening October 24 from Indonesian Skow reopening in May 2022.
